scope: Conditional single-jump regular evolutionary family selection; not an observed shock classification.

whole_radio_temperature_domain.extrema_proof: wcrit^2=10*kB*T*r/(mp*(4-r)) increases with T and r; r=(fU/fL)^2 increases with fU and decreases with fL. Extrema therefore occur at the stated paired source corners.

negative_downstream_characteristic_numer.boundary_handling: The closed box includes the excluded eta=1,t=1 degeneracy. All coefficients are nonnegative; every r-index coefficient at local eta-index=0,t-index=0 is strictly positive. Their Bernstein weights are positive for local eta<1,t<1, proving strict positivity on the declared open domain. At interior cell boundaries choose the next cell with local coordinate zero. No guard or domain was changed.

regular_FAST_certificate.meaning: For any positive inflow w>wcrit and a nondegenerate angle 0<theta<=90, a regular FAST solution exists and regular SLOW is excluded. Field-reversing alternatives fail the separate transverse evolutionary test.
regular_FAST_certificate.entropy: Positive gas-Hugoniot lower bound and dp2/dh>0; M=(4-r)*(1-eta)>0 in the open domain.
regular_FAST_certificate.excluded_endpoints: eta=1 is the gas/zero-tangential-field boundary; t=1 is switch-on; eta=0 has zero upstream pressure. No endpoint is forced into an ordinary class.

regular_SLOW_onset_certificate.domain: h=2, b=bcrit*(1+zeta), 0<zeta<=1e-4, complete saved radio-r enclosure
regular_SLOW_onset_certificate.characteristics: h>1 and r*h>1. With W<0, the certified numerator signs give upstream cslow<1<cAn and downstream 1/r<cslow. Nonzero Bt splits the characteristics for zeta>0.
regular_SLOW_onset_certificate.entropy: At zeta=0 the gas-Hugoniot entropy is positive for r>1. For W<0, d(p2/b)/db=-(r-1)^3/(b^2*r*W)>0, so entropy remains positive as zeta increases.
regular_SLOW_onset_certificate.meaning: Checked regular SLOW solutions exist arbitrarily close above ucrit as theta approaches zero. ucrit is the infimum of onset when geometry and field strength are unbounded, not proof of SLOW at every larger flow or fixed angle.
regular_SLOW_onset_certificate.not_an_observation: h=2 and its resulting small theta are explicit model coordinates. No solar normal/field/flow is inferred.
